purpose: The only edits a shipped module version may ever receive: following a recorded GitHub owner rename. GitHub embeds the owner in the top directory of api.github.com tarball archives, so a rename changes the bytes a shipped URL serves; re-recording url, strip_prefix and integrity restores one byte stream per version. scripts/owner-rename-record.mjs enforces the shape; the validate workflow proves the new integrity by building the consumer.

renames.reason: GitHub organisation renamed tinyland-inc to xoxd-ai (plan of record TIN-4435, ruling H1).
